title: Ark moved from Axum to Lake Ziway during the Italian occupation
place_text: Axum to an island on Lake Ziway, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: um the Ethiopians say that they took the ark out of Axum. Uh and they took it to another place of safekeeping.

plain: During Italy's occupation of Ethiopia, from 1935 to 1941, the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest of the Hebrew Bible, was reportedly carried out of the Ethiopian city of Axum and hidden for safekeeping on an island in Lake Ziway. The writer Graham Hancock passes this on as what Ethiopians themselves told him. If true, it would mean the Ark was really kept in Ethiopia and was moved to protect it.
